name: Transformer cooler common-failure alarm
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
summary: Collects the assigned transformer-cooling equipment failures into a clearly named bay alarm.
description: Collects the assigned transformer-cooling equipment failures into a clearly named bay alarm. Transformer monitoring interfaces connect physical sensors and protection calculations to the station's alarms and trip logic. Temperature, oil, gas, pressure and electrical measurements indicate different conditions and require separate interpretation.

In a substation transformer bay, a protection panel receives winding-current measurements and equipment alarm contacts. An operator can then distinguish an electrical protection operation from a cooling-system or physical-condition alarm. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Cooling equipment fault contacts” at the input and “Transformer cooling failure indication” at the output. Detailed fan and pump causes should remain traceable.
